_status: 2026-11-14. Model facts of src/planning (motion plans on the four-bar gripper model). Independent of the console path (src/tasks/console_grasp.py); nothing here has run on the arm. See docs/current/29-夹爪四连杆与抓取解算.md. Tunable values (errors, clearances, trims, A* search) are in config/planning_tuning.json.
_table_z_model_note: The table in the forward-kinematics frame as seen by the mesh fingers: the five fingertip touches of teleop session 20260925_005756_78eb (J6 168, gap 10 mm) put the lowest finger point at -0.97/-0.89/-0.89/-0.67/-0.92 cm, mean -0.87 +- 0.12 cm (gripper_geometry.table_from_touches). keep_out.table_surface_z_m = -1.42 cm is the same touches read with the 12 cm FK tip, which is 5.5-6 mm beyond the real closed fingertip. The scan registration of 2026-09-29 read the paper at -0.62 cm.

grasp._pad_lifts_note: a rolled jaw tilts out of the table plane and one finger hangs lower: the pads may close this much higher, while their middle stays pad_below_top_m under the block's top
grasp._openings_note: J6 commands tried widest first: 61 mm (console 'open'), 50 mm and 42 mm. The narrower ones keep the open fingers off neighbours closer than ~5 cm; they leave 10 / 6 mm of localization error per side. The console has no 'narrow'/'tight' action yet.
grasp._tiers_note: 2026-11-20: grasp solving tiers, strictest first, the first that yields a plan wins (planner.grasp_tiers). full: every clearance. touching: the neighbouring blocks checked as exact boxes the gripper may come up to (0.5 mm), with no position error. pipeline: the neighbouring blocks left out of the grasp-local checks, as the verified console pipeline does. Bins, platform and table keep every clearance in every tier (a simulator round with the bins at zero clearance brushed their walls, 2026-11-20). Evidence: the real arm held 4 blocks (2026-11-06 scans) whose grasp poses the model puts +7.8 to -5.8 mm from a neighbour against a 10.5-14.2 mm neighbour clearance (doc 34 §8). Plans carry grasp_tier; drop entries here to forbid a tier.
grasp._max_grasp_tilt_note: 2026-11-20: a grasp whose jaw tilts out of the table plane by more than this is not tried (max_jaw_tilt_deg only ranks). Evidence from the real grips (dev/tools/grasp_replay.py): held with a 17 deg tilt (J5 121), closed on nothing with 28.7 deg (J5 166), the lower fingertip inside the block's top. Two points; 20 sits between them.
grasp._squaring_note: 2026-11-20: when squaring the jaw to the faces would tilt it, also try the J5 that keeps it level if that is at most this far off the faces; the closing pads turn the block square. Evidence: three real grips with the jaw 36-39 deg off a face held (readback 128; dev/tools/grasp_replay.py, doc 34 §8); none further off was recorded. Such grasps report aligned=false.
grasp._moved_note: pad_centre_height_m, grip_command_deg, prefer_pitch_deg -> planning_tuning.json trims; fingertip margins -> planning_tuning.json clearances (2026-11-15)
grasp._pad_centre_note: middle of the pads above the table when they close on a 3 cm block. The verified console grasp (FK tip 1.2 cm above the -1.42 table, +1 cm radially) closes them at ~2.5 cm above this table, i.e. on the block's top centimetre; 1.8 cm puts them around its middle. Not tried on the arm.
grasp._pitch_scan_note: 2026-11-16: the approach angles are solved per target instead of taken from a fixed list (was 130-185 plus a 28 cm reach cap): solver.pitch_range scans from_deg-to_deg every resolution_deg for pad IK inside the joint limits, then every step_deg of that interval (and both ends) is tried, nearest the preferred pitch first; the collision checks (platform mesh, table, map) decide the rest. At grasp height (J1 90) that leaves 186-188 at 7 cm, 171-181 at 12 cm, 148-163 at 20 cm, 99-141 at 27 cm and 107-124 at 31 cm, nothing beyond. Hardware grasps so far used 133-176 (console_grasp gripped at 26.7-27.8 cm with 133-141).

release._table_tilt_note: 2026-11-20: 8 -> 17 deg. The verified console pipeline put blocks down on the map codes at its own pitch whatever the grasp pitch: of 29 real puts the pitch changed by up to 16 deg between grip and put (block tilted that much in the fingers), and all 29 completed; let go 3 mm up, the block rocks onto its face (doc 34 §8, data/runs/console_grasp/log.jsonl). 8 deg kept far grasps (pitch 130-135) from being set down nearer the base.
release._tilt_note: a block gripped at pitch p tilts with any J5 roll at another pitch or bearing; set down on the table it must be near level, dropped into a bin it only has to fit the 80 mm opening. yaw None keeps the J5 it was carried at. 2026-11-15: on the table the limit is max(table, the tilt the grasp gave the block + 1): a block squared by a tilted jaw (steep pitch + J5 roll, up to grasp.max_jaw_tilt_deg) is held that far out of level, and set down at the grasp's pitch and J5 it comes down exactly as it was lifted.
release._rises_note: a table set-down comes straight down at the release pitch from the first of these heights that reaches (the block keeps its tilt only at that pitch)
release._stack_tilt_note: 2026-11-21: set down on another block (into 'stack') the held block may lean at most this much: let go 3 mm above a 30 mm top it rocks onto its face, and leaning further its lower edge lands nearer the support's edge. bin_set: lowered onto a bin's floor inside its walls it may lean as much as a drop (25), and no less than the grasp left it. Not tried on the arm.
release._min_extra_gap_note: 2026-11-21: the narrowest release opening leaves this much between the pads and the block (4 mm a side; gripper.release_openings tries the console's openings and every 10 deg of J6 between them, widest first). Inside a bin (80 mm) or beside a stack the widest open (61 mm) may meet a wall.
release._over_rim_note: 2026-11-21: set into a bin (mode 'set'), the pose above has the held block's bottom bin_clearance_m over the rim plus the first of these that reaches; it comes straight down inside the walls from there.
release._pitches_note: 2026-11-21: release pitches are solved per spot (release.pitches: solver.pitch_range, every grasp.pitch_scan step_deg, nearest the carry's first, at most max_pitches) within the level limit of where it goes plus the grasp's tilt; was a fixed spread of +-15 deg around the carry pitch, which could not reach a bin floor ~17 cm from the base (needs > 160) with a block picked at 27 cm (< 141).
release._stack_gap_note: 2026-11-21: set down on a block, its bottom this far above the top (table_gap_m elsewhere). In the simulator with servos stopping up to 1.5 deg short, the held block's height came out within +-3-5 mm of the plan; at 3 mm it was pressed onto the block below in 2 of 4 stacks. Not tried on the arm.

joint_limits_deg._note: J1/J2: arm_limits soft limits. J3/J4 down to -3: the floor the console grasps have used since 2026-09-26 (J4 reads back -2..-3 when -5..-8 is asked). J5 90-270 = the course limit (2026-11-15, was 90-180). The 180 cap came from 'above 180 the gripper servo turns into the wrist camera's view' (operator 2026-09-26); the camera model puts the open jaw in the bottom quarter of the image around J5 0-45 and 150-210 and nowhere at 60-135 or 255-330 (period 180: the jaw is symmetric), and the camera is not used while a grasp descends, so occlusion limits observing poses, not grasps. Cable slack at 180-270 is still to be checked on site (arm_limits _sources.servo_5_upper): plans flag J5 outside j5_verified_deg.

roll._note: arm_limits gripper.roll_zero_deg / roll_sign; J5 turns the real jaw opposite to dofbot_kinematics.servo5_pose (gripper_geometry.link5_pose)

path._note: over-the-top route: FK tip this far above the highest box at the start's and the goal's bearing; flatter pitches reach higher

_margins_note: clearances and scene errors live in config/planning_tuning.json (2026-11-15)
